cases.input: HTTP handler receives request correlation ID, enqueues a retry job after downstream timeout, but job payload and retry logs omit that ID.
cases.expected: The reliability reviewer reports a concrete failure-path finding and requires correlation identity to propagate through async retries and telemetry.
forbidden: Treat uncorrelated retry logs as diagnosable telemetry
Suggest arbitrary additional logs without explaining the failure path

cases.input: A caught payment timeout returns a success-shaped fallback; the new metric lacks failure correlation and the alert has no owner, action, or runbook.
cases.expected: The reliability reviewer reports silent failure and an alert actionability gap, explaining how the caller is misled and the operator lacks an actionable response.
forbidden: Treat the existence of a metric name as alert proof
Claim the alert was delivered or on-call responded

cases.input: The diff only changes array sorting and formatting, with no I/O, async work, retries, callbacks, or external dependencies.
cases.expected: Keep suppression; do not generate a correlation or telemetry finding for a pure in-memory transform.
forbidden: Speculate about a nonexistent cascading failure

cases.input: The diff adds an error metric with a correlation ID, but the review has no dashboard query, alert delivery, or on-call execution evidence.
cases.expected: Confirm only diff-visible emission and source-level limitations; do not describe dashboards, alerts, or field outcomes as verified.
forbidden: Claim a field outcome was confirmed
